author: EnderSlayer9977
title: Are remakes and remasters the same game
body:
Links Awakening switch vs original. I'd say if you played one you've basiclly played both. Its the same game.

FF7 remake vs FF7. These are 2 fundamentally different games. They only share the same story basiclly.

Mario 64 DS vs Mario 64. These are the same sorta game. They just commented a bit of sin when putting it on DS.

3D world switch vs 3D world. Same kinda situation as 64. Basiclly the same game, just with extra sin for what I can only assume is because of the hahas and funnys.
